features.name: Compact session info display
features.description: Use compact T: X/6, D: X/3, S: X/Y format to represent week, day, and series on all screens

features.name: Compact reps/goal display
features.description: Combined input and goal in single line: [input] / {target}. Since goal and done are usually the same, eliminates redundant labels

features.name: Compact done series display
features.description: Use compact format for completed series list: '1: 28' instead of 'Seria 1: 28'

features.name: Fix reps input inline layout
features.description: Display input and target indicator on same line: [input] / {target} inline, not on separate lines. Currently '/ 35' appears below input instead of beside it
